svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or sand.gallery. Q: what's Technomads? The platform behind a public multiplayer game server, at technomads.fun. A member-facing site with Stripe-backed memberships Automated server operations over SFTP and RCON A custom launcher client, a Discord bridge, and the Java gameplay mods the server runs on Q: where did Sand study? Game and simulation programming at DeVry University (2010 to 2013), after computer science at Miami Dade College (2008 to 2010). Q: what's in Sand's stack? languages TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, SQL, Bash, C++ frontend React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js backend Node.js, Express, FastAPI, WebSockets, Firebase, Stripe desktop Electron, electron-vite, electron-builder, hardened IPC test…
